objective: Measure repeatability of adding temporal predictors over the 29-feature Phase 3A baseline.
scope: Synthetic assumption-driven simulator only; descriptive robustness, not significance or real-engine accuracy.

20261011.dataset: synthetic assumption-driven simulator; no real-engine accuracy claim

feature_controls.temporal_scope: scenario-local stable time_s sort; difference x[t]-x[t-1]; population std of t-5..t-1; no future values
feature_controls.warmup_missing: invalid values NaN with 0 validity flags; no interpolation or cross-scenario fill

classifier.imputer: median with add_indicator; fit on train for validation, then refit on train+validation
classifier.selection: validation macro-F1; test evaluated once after refit
